}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "QX29 V1.1" and "20004-A01366-YS-00-RS" are silkscreened on the main board.
"1U ASM1062 BP", "QX30 V1.1" and "20104-A01039-YS-00-RS" are silkscreened on the SATA board.
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Mindspeed]] M86201G-12 @1.2GHz :''Concerto 2000'' Dual-core ARM (Cortex-A9) *Memory: 1GB (DDR3L) SDRAM *Storage: 1MB (SPI), 512MB (NAND) Flash, 5x SATA 3.0 *Network: 2x Gigabit Ethernet ports *USB: 4x USB 3.2 (Gen 1), 1x USB 2.0 (Type A) ports *Power: 120-240V AC via C13
